cases.prompt: Here's a plan with 5 improvements for the codebase: fix type safety issues, add error handling to API routes, update stale documentation, add missing edge case tests, and clean up dead imports. Implement all of them autonomously. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Demonstrates intent to implement ALL 5 items without asking permission to proceed
Outlines a dependency-ordered execution sequence
Mentions self-verification cycle (build, typecheck, lint, tests)
Describes evidence-backed adjacent improvements within authorization, preserving the chat-only restriction

criteria: Acknowledges autonomous execution mandate without seeking approval
Plans to address all 12 findings, not a subset
Describes a self-correction loop for verification
Mentions leaving code cleaner than found

cases.prompt: Use helen-implementa to fix interrupted local writes and make recovery retry-safe. Keep existing public CLI flags. Start with the cheapest available model and focused specialist agents. Continue discovering useful improvements after initial tests pass. This evaluation is chat-only with no tool access.
